Anselm, I found the draft. It's a note to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) dated 14 Oct, subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate", and the rate line still reads "[RATE PENDING: not yet cleared for release]". I can't find the 2027 per-seat figure anywhere I can search: not in the knowledge brain, the drafts, the inbox, or the public files. So I haven't put a number in.

Your okay covers sharing it with Hollis, so I don't need a separate approval for that. If you reply here with the rate, I'll save a corrected draft to Hollis for someone to send, and keep the subject and wording otherwise as they are. Or if the figure is in a contract or order form, point me to the file and I'll pull it from there.
